# DockerDeck delivery team

In a worktree, run `sh scripts/team where` to locate the shared team. Start with [../dockerdeck-core/.ai-team/README.md](../dockerdeck-core/.ai-team/README.md) and the [CEO operating guide](../dockerdeck-core/.ai-team/CEO_GUIDE.md).

Ask your AI client:

> Act as dockerdeck-scrum-master. Read AGENTS.md and the shared team workflow. Select the highest-priority eligible story in this repository, assign independent developer, QA and reviewer sessions, and carry it through the documented merge gates. Report blockers and release readiness truthfully. Preserve unrelated work.

Native definitions are in `.codex/agents`, `.claude/agents`, `.gemini/agents` and `.agents/agents`. Use the client adapter matching your installed client. See [client setup and limitations](../dockerdeck-core/.ai-team/CLIENTS.md). A new session/reload may be required. If delegation is unavailable, use separate sessions with the canonical role prompts; never report one session's role changes as independent review.

Validate generated adapters with `python3 ../dockerdeck-core/scripts/sync-ai-team --check`.

Use branches named exactly after the story ID. For new delivery work, Done means tested, independently reviewed, committed and merged to local main. Existing migrated Done stories retain their historical acceptance and are not evidence of a main merge or release.
